geometry.view: High three-quarter, looking down into the playing bowl
geometry.proportions: Use a broad elliptical rim in projection, a visibly recessed bowl and a short skirt extending down from the near edge.
geometry.partLayout: Place twelve larger outer cells by the rim, twelve smaller cells farther in and five compact notes near the centre. Attach the stand at the far ends of the rim.
